blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: This product is only intended to be consumed by healthy individuals over the age of 18 years.

Consult with your healthcare provider if you are pregnant, nursing, taking any medications, or planning any medical procedures. Stop use immediately and consult your health care provider if you experience any adverse effects. Store in a cool and dry place. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Food supplements should not be used as a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and healthy lifestyle.
Keep out of the reach of children.
Store at room temperature and avoid excessive heat.
Do not use if seal under cap is broken or missing.
